in_marathi.name: Sailesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sailor, one who sails
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sailesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'sail' which means 'to go' or 'to journey'. This name is for one who is always on the move, be it in life or in spirit. Sailesh is a name for the sailor or one who sails through life.
